In other words, these circumstances are not putting you at risk; they are slightly protective compared to other students.

What should you do next? Since past failures carry the most weight, focus on understanding what went wrong before. Meet your teachers, ask for extra help, and use the remedial courses to close those gaps. You also have strong foundations: you have perfect attendance, which shows you are showing up ready to work. And note that every passing student in the dataset wanted to pursue higher education, while you indicated no interest. If you have doubts about your future path, talking to a counsellor might help you find a goal worth working toward. Your situation is not fixed, and this warning is an opportunity to change direction before it is too late.
